identity: ONE original veteran woman archer, the Cinderwake Longbow, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep her short swept auburn hair with a narrow bronze circlet, fitted charcoal leather and steel armour with crossed brown belts, the pointed layered rust-red waist cloth, tall dark boots, and the ragged burnt-red cape fixed by a round bronze shoulder clasp. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-RIGHT hand holds ONE tall dark recurved longbow with a carved bronze grip and small glowing orange ember cracks along its limbs; a quiver of ember-tipped arrows hangs at the screen-left hip. The screen-LEFT hand is the free string hand. Preserve the bow size, the quiver, the costume and adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, longbow, cape, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, particles or extra limbs; the bow's ember cracks keep their small steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the equipment. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour.

idle_h3_v1.action: A calm, alert idle that loops. She breathes steadily, the shoulders rise and fall, the free hand lifts toward the chest and flexes, the head turns slightly to watch the field and the bow hand shifts its grip, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted; the cape stirs gently. No walking, no drawing and no attack.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The longbow is carried upright in the screen-right hand and the free arm swings naturally; the cape trails. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE close strike toward screen right. She winds the free arm back as the knees load, then lunges forward on the front leg and drives the free fist out to full reach at screen right while the bow arm braces forward beside it, then she draws back and settles into the original stance. One strike only; the bow stays in the screen-right hand. No sword and no second strike.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Shoot ONE ember-tipped arrow toward screen right. The free hand draws one arrow from the quiver at the hip, nocks it, raises the longbow level toward screen right and pulls the string fully back to the cheek, holds the aim briefly, then releases so the arrow flies straight off toward screen right, and she lowers the bow and settles back into the original stance. One arrow only; the bow stays in the screen-right hand.

hit_h3_v1.action: One brief impact recoil and complete recovery. The head and shoulders snap backward, the free arm flies out behind her and the knees flex while she keeps hold of the longbow, then she rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Remain standing with the bow held. The impact is shown only by the body; the blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Drop into a wide low crouch and throw the free forearm up across the brow as a guard, the longbow held out in front, then rise slightly into a firm guard with the forearm still raised over the eyes and hold it on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying physical signal to allies. Raise the free hand high above the head with the palm open, hold it there briefly while the longbow stays lowered in the other hand, then lower the arm back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or emitted effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse continuously from standing: she reels back, then doubles forward, sinks onto her knees and falls forward onto her front, finishing lying motionless face down with her head toward screen right, the cape spread over her back and the longbow lying on the ground in front of her. No recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.

move_h3_v2.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The longbow is carried upright in the screen-right hand and the free arm swings naturally; the cape trails. Finish in the original gait phase. The flat blue background never changes colour, never darkens and never turns purple.

attack_h3_v2.action: Make ONE close strike toward screen right in one continuous movement. She draws the free fist back to her chest as the knees bend, then steps forward with the front boot over several frames and lunges, driving the free fist out to full reach at screen right while the bow arm braces forward beside it; she holds the reach for a moment, then steps back and settles into the original stance. The feet always move by stepping, never by jumping or snapping. One strike only; the bow stays in the screen-right hand. No sword, no arrow and no second strike.

hit_h3_v2.action: She starts rocked back from an unseen blow, head and shoulders thrown back and the free arm flung out behind her, still holding the longbow; she recovers, rebalances on both boots and returns to the original stance, then stays still. Nothing else appears in the frame: no projectile, no flash, no glow, no shadow and no change of the background.

death_h3_v2.action: Collapse slowly. Her knees buckle and she sinks down onto her knees and one hand with the longbow dropping, stays there a moment, then slumps forward and lies flat on her front, finishing motionless with her head at screen right, the cape spread over her back and the longbow lying on the ground beside her. The longbow keeps its shape and its dark wood the whole time. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
